title: Reconstruction, runtime and tooling maintenance
summary: Review ten material post-pass changes across reconstruction evidence, emulator fidelity, archive tooling and verified FPGA/runtime configurations.
notes: The CPU audit queue contained zero unresolved source/target CPU areas. No architecture was guessed and no metadata-only refresh was counted as CPU research. Primary commits were reviewed; the tracker did not independently build or execute the upstream projects.

identity.narrative: Clean-room Dungeon Master-family engine using authenticated original media. Current primary documentation records bounded startup/runtime coverage for DM1 on DOS, Atari ST, Amiga and FM Towns; CSB on Amiga, Atari ST and FM Towns; and DM2 on DOS, Amiga, FM Towns and Macintosh. The latest receipts correct DM1 Amiga HD and DM2 FM Towns boot assertions and expand the cross-game startup matrix and diagnostics. These source-owned handoffs do not establish full campaign, save, display or audio parity; Nexus and Theron's Quest remain explicitly bounded, with authentic level/campaign consumers still incomplete. These remain bounded startup/audio receipts rather than full-game parity. identity.narrative: A reconstruction of the 1988 Norsk Data ND-120 3202D CPU board from original design documents, first represented in Logisim and now maintained as Verilog. Includes CPU/decode gate arrays, PAL translations, microcode, MMU and bus devices, simulation harnesses and FPGA board integrations. This is a hardware/firmware reconstruction distinct from the catalogued nd100x and nd500x software emulators.

classification.narrative: Actual board-independent core and CPU/peripheral instantiation inspected. README claims SINTRAN III boots on Tang Nano, Nexys and MiSTer; MEGA65 bitstreams are timing-clean but not yet run on real MEGA65. Treat hardware claims as upstream reports. Root MIT licence inspected. Original 1988 design scans, firmware and other inherited material require their own provenance assessment.

source_cpu.narrative: Reconstructed architecture is ND-120 from original schematics, PAL equations and microcode.

target_cpu.narrative: Logical CPU in generated FPGA bitstream remains ND-120. FPGA vendor silicon and simulator C++ host are not claimed as native instruction-set output.

build.narrative: Primary documentation now reports physical MEGA65 R6 bring-up to OPCOM at 20 MHz with 4 MB configured main memory and a 640x480 console. Separate commits make the Nexys build synthesize its gitignored DDR2 IP checkpoint and initialize the MEGA65 framework's nested QNICE submodule in fresh clones.
build.limitations: The tracker did not synthesize or run these cores. R3 hardware is untested and SINTRAN has not yet been tried on the physical MEGA65 R6.

runtime_profiles.narrative: The verified-profile set now includes physical MEGA65 R6 bring-up: a 20 MHz ND-120 configuration with 4 MB configured main memory boots to OPCOM on a tester's board. This is one evidenced configuration, not a minimum; R3 and full SINTRAN use remain unverified.

ai.narrative: The MEGA65 hardware-status commit explicitly carries a Claude Fable 5.1 Co-Authored-By trailer, establishing bounded AI contribution evidence for this project.

relationships.narrative: Repository renamed from RonnyA/nd-120 to RetroCoreLabs/nd-120; both URLs screened. Distinct from ND100X and ND500X emulators.
